verified.fact: v501 Date plus CampaignId/AdGroupId/AdId are available at the four selected report grains. Missing required parent IDs are rejected, never synthesized.
Cost is in the user currency. returnMoneyInMicros true preserves integer currency*1,000,000 text. Vendor rounds to 10,000 micros; VAT and discounts are excluded by this query.
Clicks is vendor click count; Cost is cost of clicks. Conversions depends on goal/attribution configuration and overlapping goals must not be summed.
Report statistics use Moscow time, regardless of campaign targeting timezone.
Campaign reads expose Status, State, StatusPayment, Currency and StatusClarification. Rejection explanations are copied only when Status=REJECTED.

One CUSTOM_DATE range with stable Date/parent-ID ordering, 1,000-row offset pages and offset-specific ReportName. Stop at 5,000 rows with complete=false; valid exhausted empty results are complete. Coverage cutoff is the exclusive Moscow-midnight end capped at retrieval time; partial results keep 0.

Client-Login selects the advertiser representative. clients.get returns ClientId, Login and Currency. Canonical reads validate identity and use that currency; token/login are stored together with the existing app-credentials flow, never plugin settings.
